title: The Hazel Root — A Folk Horror Investigation
description: A year after his encounter with Baron Asselin, Lerris Fenwood has returned to the University of Thepyrgos, hollowed and haunted. The memory of his mother's eyes has been stolen. He is convinced that the Pathweaver — a mender of liminal wounds — can restore what he has lost. But the Pathweaver does not work for free. To earn her aid, Lerris must cross the Thornwood, bargain with the Hazel Queen, and survive the Huntsman's hunt. The party is drawn into the ancient war between the Alder King and the Hazel Queen, and the fragile peace that keeps the old powers at bay is about to shatter.
author: Nicholas A. Gasper

bestiary.name: The Alder King
bestiary.description: The spirit of the dark, wet wood. Patient, territorial, and cruel in the way of a snare: he does not hate you, but he will not let you go. His domain is the Thornwood, a shifting forest that appears where alders grow in circles.

sb_spends.name: Root Grasp
sb_spends.effect: Target is Grappled (Controlled Position to escape).

sb_spends.name: The King's Bargain
sb_spends.effect: Target must accept a geas or take Harm 3 (Mental).

sb_spends.name: Thornwood Manifestation
sb_spends.effect: The forest shifts; all navigation rolls are Desperate for the scene.

bestiary.weakness: Running water. The Alder King cannot cross a stream or river that flows toward the sea.

bestiary.name: The Hazel Queen
bestiary.description: The hag of crossroads and hedgerows. She offers exactly what you need — for a price you will not understand until the hazel nuts have fallen thrice. Her domain is the Hedge, a living labyrinth of thorn and hazel.

sb_spends.name: Hedge Debt
sb_spends.effect: Target owes a debt to the Hazel Queen. Mark 1 Obligation.

sb_spends.name: Crossroads Choice
sb_spends.effect: Target must choose between two bad outcomes. The Queen will honor the choice.

sb_spends.name: The Queen's Price
sb_spends.effect: Target loses a memory (GM chooses). The Queen gains 1 Boon.

bestiary.weakness: Salt. The Hazel Queen cannot cross a line of salt. She will not bargain with someone who carries a handful of salt.

bestiary.name: The Huntsman
bestiary.description: The Silent Tracker. He serves neither king nor queen — he serves the hunt itself. He appears as a tall figure in weathered leather, his face hidden by a hood of stitched leaves. His hounds are the ghosts of wolves.

sb_spends.name: The Hunt Begins
sb_spends.effect: Advance the Hunt Timer by 2 segments.

sb_spends.name: The Huntsman's Choice
sb_spends.effect: Target must sacrifice a memory or be caught (the Hunt Timer fills immediately).

bestiary.weakness: A true name. If the party discovers the Huntsman's true name and speaks it, the Hunt ends. The name is lost somewhere in the Thornwood.

bestiary.name: The Pathweaver
bestiary.description: The mender of liminal wounds. She walks where the Alder King and Hazel Queen have torn the world. She appears as an old woman with a spindle of gray thread, her fingers moving in patterns that hurt to watch.

sb_spends.name: Unknot the Way
sb_spends.effect: Open a locked door or sealed promise.

sb_spends.name: Weave the Lost Path
sb_spends.effect: Reveal a hidden route between two locations.

sb_spends.name: Mend the Threshold
sb_spends.effect: Permanently repair a broken threshold — but cost a memory.

bestiary.weakness: She cannot refuse a true request made at a crossroads — but she will exact a price for her aid.

bestiary.name: Briar Wight
bestiary.description: A traveler who died in the Thornwood, their body claimed by the Alder King's roots. They move slowly, their limbs wrapped in thorn and bark. They do not speak, but they remember who they were.

sb_spends.name: Thorn Grasp
sb_spends.effect: Target is Grappled and takes Harm 1 (piercing).

bestiary.weakness: Fire. A Briar Wight exposed to fire must test Spirit (DV 3) or flee.

acts.title: The Hollowed Scholar
acts.description: Lerris Fenwood has returned to the University, but he is not the same man who left. His mother's eyes are a void in his memory. He is desperate, reckless, and willing to risk anything to restore what he has lost. The party is drawn into his quest — and into the ancient war between the old powers.

scenes.title: The Hollowed Scholar
scenes.description: The party finds Lerris in a quiet corner of the University's Archivolt. He is pale, hollow-eyed, and clutching a lead-lined box. He speaks in fragments, his mind still scarred by the journey through the Ways Between. He offers the party a bargain: help him find the Pathweaver, and he will share what he learned about Malachai's curse.

timers.name: Hollow Attention
timers.description: How much the Hollow has noticed Lerris's quest

timers.name: Lerris's Desperation
timers.description: How close Lerris is to making a reckless bargain

outcomes.clean: You earn Lerris's trust. He shares the contents of the lead-lined box: Sister Aris's confession, a fragment of Malachai's bargain, and a single gray thread. He also reveals that the Pathweaver owes him a favor — he mended a threshold for her in his youth.
outcomes.partial: Lerris trusts you, but he is holding back. He reveals Sister Aris's confession but not the gray thread. The GM gains 1 SB.
outcomes.miss: Lerris's paranoia gets the better of him. He refuses to share anything. You must earn his trust through action.

scenes.title: The First Thread
scenes.description: Lerris reveals that the Pathweaver's favor is a single gray thread, tied to a crossroads shrine near the Thornwood. He has not used it because he fears the price. The party must decide: help him find the Pathweaver, or warn him against the bargain.

outcomes.clean: You reach the shrine without incident. The gray thread is tied to a hazel branch. Lerris touches it, and the Pathweaver appears — but she is not happy to see him. She demands a new favor: retrieve a hazel nut from the Hazel Queen's Hedge.
outcomes.partial: The Pathweaver appears, but she is guarded. She demands a price for her aid: a memory from each party member.
outcomes.miss: The Pathweaver refuses to appear. Lerris is devastated. Tick Lerris's Desperation +2.

acts.title: The War of Root and Hedge
acts.description: The party enters the Thornwood, seeking the Hazel Queen's Hedge. They are caught between the Alder King's dark patience and the Hazel Queen's cunning bargains. The Huntsman begins to hunt them. The Pathweaver watches from the edges.

scenes.title: The Thornwood
scenes.description: The forest is wrong. The trees are too close, the light too dim, the roots too eager. Navigation is impossible. The party must find the Hedge before the Thornwood claims them.

timers.name: Thornwood Timer
timers.description: How deeply the forest has claimed the party

timers.name: The Hunt Timer
timers.description: How close the Huntsman is to catching the party

outcomes.clean: You find a path through the forest. Tick Thornwood Timer -2. You see a clearing ahead — the Hedge.
outcomes.partial: You make progress, but the forest shifts behind you. Tick Thornwood Timer +1. The path is still ahead.
outcomes.miss: You are lost. Tick Thornwood Timer +2. The forest closes in.

outcomes.clean: You defeat the Briar Wights. One of them drops a hazel nut — a token of the Hazel Queen.
outcomes.partial: You defeat them, but one escapes. It will report your presence to the Alder King. Tick Thornwood Timer +1.
outcomes.miss: You are overwhelmed. Tick Thornwood Timer +2 and mark 1 Fatigue for each PC.

scenes.title: The Hazel Queen's Hedge
scenes.description: The Hedge is a living labyrinth of thorn and hazel. The Hazel Queen is waiting. She offers Lerris a choice: she can restore his mother's eyes — but only if he brings her a thorn from the Alder King's crown. The party must decide: accept the Queen's bargain, or find another way.

timers.name: Hedge Debt Timer
timers.description: How much the party owes the Hazel Queen

outcomes.clean: You negotiate a fair bargain: the Hazel Queen will restore Lerris's memory in exchange for a single thorn from the Alder King's crown. She also warns you that the Huntsman is close — and that the Alder King will not give up his thorn willingly.
outcomes.partial: The Queen agrees, but she demands a memory from each party member as collateral. Mark 1 Obligation to the Hazel Queen.
outcomes.miss: The Queen refuses to bargain. She demands Lerris stay with her as a hostage. Tick Hedge Debt +3.

acts.title: The Huntsman's Hunt
acts.description: The party must retrieve the Alder King's thorn. But the King is not willing to part with it. The Huntsman is closing in. The Pathweaver offers a third path — but her aid comes at a price. Lerris must decide how far he is willing to go to restore what he has lost.

scenes.title: The Alder King's Throne
scenes.description: The party finds the Alder King's throne — a massive alder tree at the heart of the Thornwood. The King is waiting. He offers a bargain: a thorn from his crown, in exchange for a seed from the Hazel Queen's Hedge. The party must decide: accept the King's bargain, or fight for the thorn.

outcomes.clean: You negotiate a fair bargain: the Alder King will give you a thorn in exchange for a seed from the Hazel Queen's Hedge. He also warns you that the Huntsman is already here — and that he is not the only one hunting you.
outcomes.partial: The King agrees, but he demands a service: bring him the head of the Huntsman. The party must choose between the King and the Hunt.
outcomes.miss: The King refuses to bargain. He attacks. Combat begins.

scenes.title: The Pathweaver's Third Path
scenes.description: The Pathweaver appears at the crossroads between the Thornwood and the Hedge. She offers a third path: she will restore Lerris's memory herself — but only if he agrees to become her student, learning to mend thresholds for the rest of his life. The party must decide: accept the Pathweaver's bargain, or continue the war.

outcomes.clean: Lerris accepts the Pathweaver's bargain. She restores his memory — but he is now her apprentice. He will leave the University and walk the ways between. The party gains a permanent ally in the Pathweaver.
outcomes.partial: Lerris accepts, but he is changed. He gains the Condition 'Hollowed by the Path' (-1 die to social rolls with ordinary people).
outcomes.miss: Lerris refuses. The Pathweaver vanishes. Tick Lerris's Desperation +2. The party must find another way.

acts.title: The Final Reckoning
acts.description: The Huntsman has caught up with the party. The Alder King and Hazel Queen watch from the edges. Lerris must make a final choice: accept the Pathweaver's bargain, take the thorn, or find another path. The Hollow watches. The thread tightens.

scenes.title: The Huntsman's Court
scenes.description: The Huntsman corners the party at a crossroads. He offers no bargain — only a choice: one member of the party stays behind as a sacrifice, or the entire party faces his hounds. Lerris is willing to sacrifice himself. The party must decide.

outcomes.clean: You find the Huntsman's true name (hidden in a Briar Wight's memory) and speak it. The Huntsman retreats. The Hunt ends. Tick The Hunt Timer to 0.
outcomes.partial: You speak the name, but it is corrupted. The Huntsman is weakened, but not banished. Tick The Hunt Timer -4.
outcomes.miss: You fail to speak the name. The Huntsman attacks. Combat begins.

scenes.title: Resolution Paths
scenes.description: Lerris's memory is restored — but the war between the Alder King and the Hazel Queen continues. The party must choose how to end the conflict, or how to survive it.

outcomes.clean: The Pathweaver weaves a truce between the King and Queen. The war is frozen for a generation. Award 15-18 XP. Lerris becomes the Pathweaver's apprentice.
outcomes.partial: The truce is fragile. The King and Queen agree to a temporary ceasefire. Award 12-15 XP.
outcomes.miss: The truce fails. The war continues. Tick Threshold Fracture +3.

outcomes.clean: The Huntsman is bound to the party's service. He will hunt the party's enemies — but the price is a memory each season. Award 18-20 XP.
outcomes.partial: The Huntsman agrees to a single hunt. Award 12-15 XP.
outcomes.miss: The Huntsman escapes. He will hunt the party again.

outcomes.clean: The party offers a memory to the Hollow to settle the war. The King and Queen are both diminished. Award 12-15 XP. The party is marked by the Hollow.
outcomes.partial: The Hollow accepts the bargain, but the party is changed. Mark 1 Corruption for each PC.
outcomes.miss: The Hollow refuses. The war continues. Tick Hollow Attention +3.

npcs.name: Lerris Fenwood
npcs.role: Hollowed Scholar, Fifth Son of Duke Braedon Fenwood
npcs.motivation: Restore his mother's memory, which was stolen by the Baron Asselin
npcs.secret: He carries a lead-lined box containing Sister Aris's confession. He is marked by the Hollow.

npcs.name: The Alder King
npcs.role: Spirit of the Dark, Wet Wood
npcs.motivation: Expand his domain; punish those who enter his territory
npcs.secret: He fears the Pathweaver. She has mended thresholds that he once claimed.

npcs.name: The Hazel Queen
npcs.motivation: Collect debts; expand her influence through bargains
npcs.secret: She once loved the Alder King. The war began when he refused her bargain.

npcs.name: The Huntsman
npcs.motivation: Hunt those who disturb the old powers
npcs.secret: He was once mortal. His true name is carved into the Alder King's throne.

npcs.name: The Pathweaver
npcs.motivation: Restore balance; mend what the war has broken
npcs.secret: She is the third sister — the one who was forgotten by the King and Queen.

npcs.name: Sister Aris
npcs.motivation: Confess her sins; warn others of Malachai's bargain
npcs.secret: She is the mother of Bryn, who now serves the Cord. The Hollowed child she raised was never truly free.

locations.name: The Archivolt, University of Thepyrgos
locations.description: The main hall of the Library of Keys. Witness's Archivists hold court. Lerris has been hiding here, reading forbidden texts.

locations.name: The Thornwood
locations.description: A shifting forest that appears where alders grow in circles. The Alder King's domain. Paths lead nowhere. Roots reach for the unwary.

locations.name: The Hazel Queen's Hedge
locations.description: A living labyrinth of thorn and hazel. The Hazel Queen's domain. Each path offers a choice. Each choice has a price.

locations.name: The Crossroads Shrine
locations.description: A place where the Pathweaver appears. The gray thread is tied to a hazel branch. The air smells of honey and old promises.

locations.name: The Alder King's Throne
locations.description: A massive alder tree at the heart of the Thornwood. The King's crown is woven from living branches. His throne is a nest of roots.

factions.name: The Alder King
factions.goals: Expand his domain; punish trespassers; win the war against the Hazel Queen
factions.relationship: The party must negotiate with him — or fight him.

factions.name: The Hazel Queen
factions.goals: Collect debts; expand her influence through bargains; win the war against the Alder King
factions.relationship: The party must bargain with her — or pay the price.

factions.name: The Huntsman
factions.goals: Hunt those who disturb the old powers; serve the hunt itself
factions.relationship: The party is being hunted. They must evade or confront him.

factions.name: The Pathweaver
factions.goals: Restore balance; mend what the war has broken
factions.relationship: The party's best hope for a third path.

factions.name: Lerris Fenwood
factions.goals: Restore his mother's memory; find the Pathweaver
factions.relationship: The party's client. He is desperate, reckless, and willing to pay any price.

campaignTimers.name: Thornwood Timer
campaignTimers.description: How deeply the forest has claimed the party. Advances when the party enters the Thornwood, rests, or harms a creature of the wood. At 9–10, the Alder King manifests and offers a bargain — or a trap.

campaignTimers.name: Hedge Debt Timer
campaignTimers.description: How much the party owes the Hazel Queen. Advances when the party accepts her aid, breaks a promise, or fails to pay a debt. At 7–8, the Queen appears and demands payment.

campaignTimers.name: The Hunt Timer
campaignTimers.description: How close the Huntsman is to catching the party. Advances each day of travel, plus additional ticks for leaving traces or using magic. When full, the Huntsman corners the party and offers no bargain — only a choice.

campaignTimers.name: Threshold Fracture
campaignTimers.description: How close the war is to breaking reality. Advances when the party takes sides, breaks a bargain, or kills a fae creature. When full, the ninth threshold opens and something enters — something even the King and Queen fear.

campaignTimers.name: Hollow Attention
campaignTimers.description: How much the Hollow has noticed Lerris's quest. Advances when he speaks of Malachai, opens the lead-lined box, or lingers in thresholds. When full, the Hollow Bride appears — offering a bargain, demanding a price.

campaignTimers.name: Lerris's Desperation
campaignTimers.description: How close Lerris is to making a reckless bargain. Advances when the party fails to help him, when he is reminded of his loss, or when the Hollow speaks. When full, Lerris will accept any bargain — even a deadly one.

notes: A folk horror investigation bridging the Chained Angel Archives and the war between the Alder King and Hazel Queen. Lerris Fenwood returns as a hollowed, desperate figure. The party must navigate the Thornwood, bargain with the Hazel Queen, and survive the Huntsman's hunt. The Pathweaver offers a third path — but her aid comes at a price. Themes: memory, identity, the cost of knowledge, and the ancient war between the old powers. This adventure sets up Lerris's next canonical appearance as the Pathweaver's apprentice.
